newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no sales - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no sales - USDA.

text.p: Nebraska's feedlot cattle market was at a standstill near midday Monday, with light bids at $109.00 per cwt on a dressed basis passed by owners pricing cattle at $112.00, market sources said.
There were no reported bids on a live basis, but owners were pricing cattle at $70.00, sources said.
Last week's showlist was sold out in active trade, mostly at $110.00, although there a few sales were reported at $110.50. There also were sales last week at $68.00 to $68.50 on a live basis.
This week's showlist was expected to be unchanged to slightly smaller than last week's estimated 80,000 head.
